biotools.summary: PROSTATEx ADC Ratio is a software resource focusing on enhancing prostate cancer classification using ADC ratio in a multicenter benchmarking study. It leverages the ProstateX dataset available within the Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) and employs radiomics techniques.
